topic: Campaign planner functionality and slot limits
summary_markdown:
The session focused on multiple technical issues within the Campaign Planner, particularly for the Finnish environment. Initial problems included incorrect default values and validation errors (e.g., 'unknown' user frame ID). Later discussions addressed system instability when calculating metrics across all frames due to frequency calculations.

A key functional gap identified was the lack of visibility into the maximum possible number of slots a campaign can contain based on selected frames, loop duration, and slot duration. It was proposed that the Campaign Planner should display an informational text near the filters stating: "For current filters maximum number of slots is {max_possible_n_slots}", where this value is calculated as $\text{max}(\text{loop\_duration\_frame\_campaign} \times \text{n\_loops\_campaign} / \text{slot\_duration\_frame\_campaign})$ for all selected frames.

Several fixes were deployed, including ensuring that only active environments are considered and addressing issues with empty frames having a 'Ready' status.
decisions: Implement an informational text in the Campaign Planner showing the maximum possible number of slots based on current filter selections.
The formula for displaying max slots is $\text{max}(\text{loop\_duration\_frame\_campaign} \times \text{n\_loops\_campaign} / \text{slot\_duration\_frame\_campaign})$ across all selected frames.
action_items: Implement the informational text displaying max slots in the Campaign Planner.
